prompt_meta.title: Games GA Hardening: approval workflow + private invites + host management + pagination/filters + in-app notifications (store-only)

owner_actions.when: after STEP-0006 report is shared with ChatGPT
owner_actions.instruction: Approve the final rules for: (1) Approval-based joins, (2) Private game invitations, (3) Waitlist promotion behavior. (IDE documents in ops/GAME_RULES.md updates.)

step_objectives.goal: Make Games feature GA-ready by completing approval joins, private invites, host management, pagination/filtering, and auditable in-app notifications.
outcomes: Approval joinPolicy fully supported across API/Web/Mobile (request → approve/deny → state transitions)
Private games supported with invite mechanism (link/code/token) and host controls
Host management UX exists (requests, participants, waitlist, cancel/edit)
Game list endpoints have pagination + stable ordering and better filters
In-app notifications are persisted and viewable (no push delivery required yet)
Comprehensive tests exist for OPEN + APPROVAL + PRIVATE flows
constraints: No payments, no venue booking integrations, no chat/messaging.
IDE chooses invite mechanism (token/code/link) and must document security tradeoffs.
Must build on existing auth + onboarding gating.
definition_of_done: IDE ensures Docker/infra is running (auto-start if needed) and migrations applied
API tests cover: OPEN join, APPROVAL join, PRIVATE invites, capacity/waitlist, host permissions
Web supports: create/edit/cancel + host manage + invite + approvals
Mobile supports: list/detail/join + approval state visibility + invite join flow + basic host manage (at least approve/deny and cancel); if any host tools deferred, document precisely
In-app notifications can be listed/marked read on Web and Mobile
Docs updated/added: ops/GAME_RULES.md, ops/API_CONTRACTS.md, ops/INVITE_MODEL.md, ops/NOTIFICATIONS_MODEL.md

deliverables_outcomes.goal: No manual owner actions; infra must be up.
requirements: Ensure Docker daemon is running (auto-start/install attempt as needed).
Ensure infra containers are up (compose up if needed).
Run migrations for any new models/fields.
acceptance_criteria: Report contains docker info + compose ps evidence

deliverables_outcomes.goal: APPROVAL flow must be complete and consistent.
requirements: When joinPolicy=APPROVAL: joining creates a REQUESTED state; host can APPROVE or DENY.
Capacity rules enforced: APPROVED counts toward capacity; REQUESTED does not (unless IDE decides otherwise and documents).
Waitlist interaction defined and implemented consistently (document rules).
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover REQUESTED → APPROVED/DENIED transitions and permissions
Web+Mobile UI shows correct state for requester and host

deliverables_outcomes.goal: PRIVATE games must be joinable only via invitation.
requirements: Define and implement an invitation mechanism (invite token/code/link) for private games.
Host can create/revoke invites and view invite usage (basic).
Non-invited users cannot join private games via list/discovery (server-side enforced).
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover access control for PRIVATE games
Docs include security considerations (guessability, expiry, revocation)

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Host can manage the game without hacks.
requirements: Host can: approve/deny requests, remove participants if rules allow (optional), cancel game, edit basic details (time/capacity/notes) within defined constraints.
All actions must be permission-checked server-side.
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover host-only actions and reject non-host attempts
Web host manage UX exists and is localized

requirements: Games list endpoint supports pagination (cursor or page) with stable sorting (e.g., startTime then id).
Filters include: sportId, time window, status, visibility, homeArea (and any other existing preference-based filters as feasible).
Return shape should include enough info to render cards without extra round trips (IDE decides; document).
acceptance_criteria: API tests validate pagination consistency and filter correctness

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Auditable user communication foundation without push delivery yet.
requirements: Persist notifications for key events: join requested, approved, denied, cancelled, waitlist promoted (as applicable).
Provide endpoints to list notifications and mark read.
Web + Mobile screens to view notifications list.
acceptance_criteria: API tests cover creation and read/unread behavior
Web + Mobile render notifications and can mark read

deliverables_outcomes.goal: Clear rules and contracts for GA.
requirements: Update ops/GAME_RULES.md to include APPROVAL + PRIVATE + waitlist rules clearly.
Update ops/API_CONTRACTS.md with new endpoints/fields.
Create ops/INVITE_MODEL.md describing invitation mechanism + security.
Create ops/NOTIFICATIONS_MODEL.md describing notification types and payloads.

tasks.name: Ensure infra running (executor-owned)
tasks.objective: Auto-start Docker/infra and confirm DB connectivity.
acceptance: docker + infra running OR BLOCKED with exact OS/permission limitation

tasks.name: Approval joins + host actions
tasks.objective: Complete APPROVAL workflow end-to-end with tests and localized UI.

tasks.name: Private invites
tasks.objective: Implement invitation mechanism + host controls + tests.
acceptance: Private access enforced; invite flow works

tasks.name: Pagination/filters hardening
tasks.objective: Implement stable pagination and improve filtering with tests.

tasks.name: In-app notifications
tasks.objective: Persist and render notifications; mark read.

tasks.name: Docs + manifest + report
tasks.objective: Update docs, update manifest, produce complete report.
acceptance: Docs complete; manifest updated; report complete

final_instruction_to_ide: Execute this prompt exactly. Do not delegate any execution to the owner. Choose implementation freely. Update ops/manifest.json and write a complete reports/STEP-0006.report.json with no placeholders.
